name: Rest Your Hands
description: A short pause to let your hands, arms and shoulders go still and heavy.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Five short steps for letting the hands and arms rest, on Guided Pause.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Stop after any step.
howToPlay: Press Begin and move your hands off the keyboard.
Follow each step in your own time. It moves on by itself.
Press Next to skip a step or Back to repeat one.
tips: This is a break, not advice. Skip any step that does not suit you, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.
